variants.headline: Home world changes the charter
variants.sub: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has changed the colony's charter. A change to the governing framework deserves a precise account, not a guess at the powers affected. In considering {target}, readers should distinguish the fact of amendment from any particular new permission or restriction not specified in this report.

Workers have a stake in the framework within which political choices are made. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Colonial charter amended
variants.sub: The colony's charter has been altered by the home world.
variants.body:
The terms under which the colony is governed have a recorded amendment: the home world has changed the charter. For {target}, the event invites scrutiny of authority and legitimacy. It does not license an invented account of which local decisions have become lawful or unlawful.

Workers have a stake in the framework within which political choices are made. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: The terms of authority are altered
variants.sub: The home world has changed the colony's charter.
variants.body:
A charter amendment has been made by the home world. The change belongs to the colony's legal framework, while its detailed operation is a separate matter. Readers judging {target} should be able to discuss the use of authority without accepting unspecified legal consequences as established facts.

Workers have a stake in the framework within which political choices are made. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
